title.en: An Act Limiting the Rate of Salary or Wage Which An Employee or Laborer of the Government Marine Railway and Repair Shops Employed Under Act Numbered Forty- One Hundred and Eleven May Receive.

text.en:
Unless otherwise specifically provided in the annual Appropriation Act, no employee or laborer
of the Government Marine Railway and Repair Shops employed under Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and
eleven shall be paid more than ten pesos per day or more than two hundred and fifty pesos per month.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 9, 1936.
